"""Explicit, lossless constructed-engineering evidence; no private data traversal."""
from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
import json
ROOT=next(p for p in Path(__file__).resolve().parents if (p/'src/lupine_discovery/decision_pool.py').is_file())
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def main():
    destination=HERE/'conformance-promotion-evidence-v3'
    if destination.exists():raise RuntimeError('OUTPUT_ALREADY_EXISTS')
    own=['contract-conformance-proposal-v1.md','contract-conformance-integration-v1.md',
         'companion-observability-proposal-v3.md','companion-observability-clarification-v3.md',
         'run_contract_author.py','run_companion_author_v3.py','build_conformance_bundle.py','build_conformance_bundle_v3.py',
         'reports/contract-author-v1.json','reports/contract-author-v1.log',
         'reports/contract-author-v2.json','reports/contract-author-v2.log',
         'reports/contract-driver-first.log','reports/contract-driver-second.log','reports/contract-driver-third.log',
         'reports/contract-producer-hold-v1.json','reports/contract-producer-hold-v2.json','reports/contract-producer-hold-v3.json',
         'reports/companion-observability-first-v3.log','reports/companion-observability-final-v3.log','reports/companion-observability-author-v3.json',
         'reports/contract-peer-references-v3.json',
         'pre-decisions-fix-v1/mpea_archive_decisions.py',
         'pre-observability-v2/manifest-v2.json','pre-observability-v2/contract-conformance-integration-v1.md',
         'pre-observability-v2/integration-note-reconstruction-v2.json',
         'promotion-contract-v2/manifest-v2.json','promotion-contract-v3/manifest-v3.json']
    sources={str((HERE/name).relative_to(ROOT)):None for name in own}
    for version in ('v2','v3'):
        promotion=json.loads((HERE/f'promotion-contract-{version}/manifest-{version}.json').read_bytes())
        for record in promotion['files']:
            # Earlier live sources were prospectively revised. Preserve the exact
            # retained candidate copies bound by each historical promotion map.
            sources[record['candidate']]={'bytes':record['bytes'],'sha256':record['sha256']}
            if record.get('diff'):sources[record['diff']]=None
    snapshots=json.loads((HERE/'pre-observability-v2/manifest-v2.json').read_bytes())
    for record in snapshots['files']:sources[record['snapshot']]={'bytes':record['bytes'],'sha256':record['sha256']}
    captured=[]
    for name,expected in sorted(sources.items()):
        path=ROOT/name
        if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file() or '..' in path.parts:raise RuntimeError('UNEXPECTED_SOURCE')
        raw=path.read_bytes();identity={'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
        if expected is not None and identity!=expected:raise RuntimeError('COPYSET_IDENTITY_MISMATCH')
        raw.decode('utf-8');captured.append((name,raw,identity))
    destination.mkdir();(destination/'artifacts').mkdir();records=[]
    for index,(name,raw,identity) in enumerate(captured,1):
        wrapper={'schema':'lupine.lossless.utf8-evidence.v1','original_path':name,**identity,'utf8':raw.decode('utf-8')}
        encoded=(json.dumps(wrapper,sort_keys=True,indent=2,ensure_ascii=True)+'\n').encode()
        relative=f'artifacts/{index:04d}.json';(destination/relative).write_bytes(encoded)
        if json.loads(encoded)['utf8'].encode('utf-8')!=raw:raise RuntimeError('RESTORATION_MISMATCH')
        records.append({'original_path':name,**identity,'retained_path':relative,'retained_bytes':len(encoded),'retained_sha256':sha256(encoded).hexdigest(),'encoding':'lossless_utf8_json'})
    manifest={'schema':'lupine.mpea.conformance-evidence-copyset.v3',
        'scope':'explicit constructed-data engineering source/tests/logs; all historical failures and v2 author31 retained; final v3 author8 separate; no real archive, feature table, targets or allocation artifacts',
        'artifacts':records,'artifact_count':len(records),'original_bytes':sum(r['bytes'] for r in records),
        'retained_artifact_bytes':sum(r['retained_bytes'] for r in records),'all_restored_bytes_verified':True,
        'separate_peer_evidence':json.loads((HERE/'reports/contract-peer-references-v3.json').read_bytes())}
    raw=(json.dumps(manifest,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n').encode();(destination/'copy-manifest-v3.json').write_bytes(raw)
    (destination/'README.md').write_text('''# Prospective MPEA conformance producer evidence\n\nEvery named original is stored losslessly in a UTF-8 JSON wrapper. Decode its\n`utf8` string and encode as UTF-8 to recover exact original bytes, then verify\nits original size and SHA-256. Patches/log trailing whitespace are preserved.\n\nHistorical failures, held-v1/v2 sources and the successful v2 author31 receipt\nremain labeled as historical. The v3 correction changes common companion\nmetadata/validation, with eight focused author checks. It does not change\nnumerical algorithms or reopen actual data. Independent peer receipts are\nreferenced separately rather than duplicated; the root main suite is separate.\n\nThe original v2 integration note was reconstructed by removing only the appended\nv3 section and checking the retained v2 execution SHA. Its reconstruction record\nstates this explicitly. All other declared promotion copies/snapshots retain\ntheir original exact hashes. No recursive attempt directory or scientific input\nis included. This is engineering evidence, not scientific registration or a\nperformance result.\n''')
    seal={'schema':'lupine.evidence-bundle-seal.v1','files':{str(p.relative_to(destination)):{'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in sorted(destination.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}}
    (destination/'bundle-seal-v3.json').write_text(json.dumps(seal,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({'artifacts':manifest['artifact_count'],'original_bytes':manifest['original_bytes'],'retained_bytes_excluding_seal':sum(v['bytes'] for v in seal['files'].values()),'manifest_sha256':sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'bundle_seal_sha256':sha256((destination/'bundle-seal-v3.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()},sort_keys=True))
if __name__=='__main__':main()
